package.name: freecad-fusion
package.description: Make FreeCAD feel like Autodesk Fusion: drag the NaviCube to orbit, Fusion mouse navigation (Shift+middle orbit, middle pan, zoom at cursor) and Fusion single-key shortcuts (L, R, C, D, X, T, O, P, E, H, F, M, I, A). Fully reversible.

other.name: freecad-fusion
other.description: Fusion-style navigation, NaviCube drag-to-orbit and shortcuts
